reviewed_findings.finding: Francisco Couzo published this refinement before Evan Daniel issue 465. The two certificates state exactly the same side and share 152 exact poses. The construction starts from SQUISH.

reviewed_findings.finding: Couzo issue 451 predates Mishapolk issue 470 by 15 hours 18 minutes. The latter gives equal or slightly larger sides for these refinements. Preserve the starting construction credits: Ryan Xu at 108/127/131, SQUISH and Siddharth Gupta at 180, Couzo at 306.

Evan Daniel issue 489 introduced the lower Hunt 3 basin. Couzo issues 476/488 describe earlier, larger packings. A later precision certificate or matching local copy does not transfer Hunt 3 discovery credit.

Evan Daniel issue 669 is a different local minimum from Ostashev T-149, reached using that packing as the start. Credit Daniel for the new packing and retain Ostashev as the seed author. This is separate from the 451/465 historical tie.
Evan Daniel issue 659 refines a reconstruction of the SQUISH Mondrian composition in issue 481. Preserve SQUISH construction credit and Daniel refinement credit.
Evan Daniel issue 664 explicitly refines Couzo issue 561, which refines SQUISH issue 500. It is a new refinement, not a claim to the underlying construction.

Joost de Winter issue 668 precedes Couzo issue 672. Our later 227 and 229 refinements retain de Winter construction credit; 260 is an adopted source result, not our discovery. Most of the 229 certified-side gain is reduced certificate dilation.

These are de Winter source results, already imported. Retain Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev for the underlying staircase/four-block method. Later Couzo relaxations or L-border/deletion descendants retain that lineage.

The refined arrangements were reported in Couzo issue 583 at 14:11:17Z. Mishapolk committed the matching tighter certificate at 15:51:54Z, before Couzo precision commit b85dee2 at 17:30:53Z. Couzo issue 586 still predates Mishapolk issue 593. Thus issue order and equal-certificate commit order differ. Both continue Daniil Ostashev constructions; neither date transfers that original construction credit.

The 70a033f certificates provide further exact precision improvements. Jlevy explicitly preserves Ostashev packing credit at 129/175/176/204/232/264/303/304 and Couzo refinement credit at 154/156/271/302, together with their earlier seed lineages. These are not twelve new construction discoveries.

Certificate precision and exact attainment retain PingYou Ltd credit. The submission expressly preserves construction, preceding refinement and source/tool authorship; its 148 cumulative counts are not 148 newly discovered nominal constructions. All supplements were already imported.

Kevin Fang is the construction author of these composites. Couzo contribution in that submission was regeneration and exact replay. Later smaller numerical records at the same n are separate refinements.
